annotations.title: Weather for one place or lat/lon (paid, x402)

description: PAID: current conditions, the next 12 hourly steps and up to 7 daily rows for one point, plus when it next rains there, for $0.0100. Name a place, a lat/lon, or up to four places in ONE paid call; a place is geocoded in the same call and its days are dated in its own time zone. MET Norway (api.met.no) plus OpenStreetMap; both attributions ride in the answer. Unpaid, it returns the price; pay with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana, Polygon, Arbitrum, Avalanche, Sei or X Layer) in _meta['x402/payment'] and call again. Feedback: POST /feedback (free). Read daily; no individual reply.

days.description: Daily rows (local dates) to return, 1..7. Omitted means 3. Same price.

lat.description: Latitude in degrees, -90..90, e.g. 59.9127. Needed unless `place` is sent.

lon.description: Longitude in degrees, -180..180, e.g. 10.7461. Needed unless `place` is sent.

place.description: A town, city or address instead of coordinates, e.g. "Kyoto". Same price; wins over lat/lon.

places.description: Up to 4 places in one paid call, same price; the answer is one row per place in this order.

window.description: Ask for the scheduling ANSWER: the earliest run of `hours` consecutive forecast hours where EVERY hour meets every bound you state, as `bestWindow` (or null plus `bestWindowReason` naming the bound that failed). With `places` the answer also names the CHOICE: `bestOf` is the row whose window starts earliest. Same price. `notBefore`/`notAfter` are ISO instants bounding WHEN it may run: an hour joins only if its whole hour is inside them.
